parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can call the DescribeInstances operation to obtain the bastion host instance ID.

parameters.name: Principals
parameters.description: The information about the auditors associated with the audit policy.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: ReviewRuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the audit policy.
> You can call the ListReviewRules operation to obtain this parameter.
